name: maru-activity-companion
description: Private, local VS Code activity for the MaruActivityPanel Vencord plugin.

maruActivity.enabled.description: Send only selected editor metadata to the paired Discord plugin on this computer.

maruActivity.port.description: Loopback bridge port. Must match MaruActivityPanel in Discord.

maruActivity.idleSeconds.description: Mark the editor idle after this many seconds without editor interaction. Unfocused windows are immediately idle.

maruActivity.shareWorkspace.description: Send the workspace label (never an absolute path).

maruActivity.shareFile.description: Send the active file basename and language, never its content or full path.

maruActivity.shareCursor.description: Send the active cursor line and column. No selected text is read.

maruActivity.shareDuration.description: Send the workspace session start time.

maruActivity.shareRepository.description: Send a sanitized HTTPS repository URL from the built-in Git extension, when available.
